name: quiver
description: Desktop DB client for Amazon RDS Aurora via RDS Data API

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:preload" "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run typecheck:preload && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test:e2e:failure: npm run build && cross-env QUVER_E2E_FAIL=profiles:list:throw playwright test --config=playwright.config.js --project=fault-injection
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build && playwright test --config=playwright.config.js e2e/specs/app.smoke.spec.js --project=ministack
scripts.test:e2e:fault:nightly: npm run build && cross-env QUVER_E2E_FAIL=credentials:list:throw,credentials:list-from-directory:throw,rds:list-db-clusters:throw,rds:test-connection:throw,rds:list-tables:throw,rds:list-table-columns:throw,rds:execute-query:throw,profiles:list:throw,profiles:create:throw,profiles:update:throw,profiles:delete:throw playwright test --config=playwright.config.js --project=fault-injection
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run verify:dist && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run verify:dist && electron-builder --publish never --linux AppImage --x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run verify:dist && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg --x64 --arm64
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run verify:dist && npm run check:win-env && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --x64
scripts.ministack:reset: docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml down -v && npm run ministack:up && npm run ministack:init
